Name: Annoying Dog Skin for Adopt 'n Skin and Alternative Textures
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size]
Have you ever wished your Stardew Dog was prolific video game creator and musician, Toby Fox? Well now they can be! Using the Annoying Dog skin for Adopt n' Skin and other reskin mods! Ready to rename and drag and drop to join your collection!
He walks! He sleeps! He flies around! His tail even ignites, they're all features!! Which you can have today if you use Adopt n' Skin or another dog reskin mod.

What's that? You're sad that these retexture mods might not work in multiplayer? Have no fear! With new [b]ALTERNATIVE TEXTURE[/b] TECHNOLOGY, you can bring your Annoying Dog into your multiplayer farm so that all your friends may bask in his glory!


[b][u]CREDITS[/u]
[/b]Skins were reformatted, tested, and put together by TerraTerraCotta.
[i](These Skins were tested using Adopt N' Skin)

[/i][url=https://www.spriters-resource.com/custom_edited/undertalecustoms/sheet/118603/]The Custom Annoying Dog Sprites are by Pepeztyle on the Spriter's Resource[/url]
